2609.03807.title: Free Pause Tokens
2609.03807.paper_summary: A free pause token gives a language model extra compute to form each next-token prediction (as a pause, or thinking, token does) but carries that compute in a parallel prediction stream over a weight-shared backbone rather than as an extra token in the sequence. It improves next-token prediction by 2-3 centinats in practice on a 1B parameter model. Because the pause rides an existing position instead of adding one, it is free to use: at inference it adds no context length, no KV cache, and essentially no latency with the growth in inference flops typically irrelevant as it is not the active bottleneck on throughput. The only primary cost is in training, where additional training compute versus an optimized pretraining pipeline is reduced to as low as x1.14 while preserving most of the benefits. The result is an isoflop, isoparameter, and isotoken improvement over standard next token trained transformers.
2609.03807.paper_summary_zh: 一個自由的暫停標記為語言模型提供了額外的計算能力，以形成每個下一個標記的預測（就像暫停或思考標記所做的那樣），但它在一個平行的預測流中攜帶這些計算，而不是作為序列中的額外標記。它在實踐中對於一個10億參數的模型改善了2-3個centinats的下一個標記預測。由於暫停標記利用現有的位置而不是添加一個，因此它是免費使用的：在推理時，它不增加上下文長度，沒有KV緩存，並且由於推理的flops增長通常與吞吐量的主動瓶頸無關，基本上沒有延遲。唯一的主要成本在於訓練，其中額外的訓練計算與優化的預訓練管道相比減少到低至x1.14，同時保留大部分好處。其結果是在標準下一個標記訓練的Transformer上實現了等flop、等參數和等標記的改進。
